### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Country scope. Grant the bank company that matches this country's currency
### law, giving it the slot first.
###
### ORDER MATTERS AND IT COST A ROUND TO FIND OUT. The slot has to be granted
### BEFORE add_company, not after. Finland owns a central bank and no company
### slots at all in 1836 -- add_company simply had nowhere to put the company,
### and the +1 arrived a line too late to help.

	}

	}

	}
	else_if = {

		add_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_bank_rupee_indonesian_rupiah
	}

		add_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_bank_spe_baht
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { c:DAI ?= this }
		add_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_bank_spe_dong
	}
	else_if = {

		add_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_bank_spe_drachma
	}
	else_if = {

		add_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_bank_spe_korean_won
	}
	else_if = {

		add_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_bank_spe_peseta
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { c:RUS ?= this }
		add_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_bank_spe_ruble
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { c:JAP ?= this }
		add_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_bank_spe_yen
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { c:CHI ?= this }
		add_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_bank_spe_yuan
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { c:POL ?= this }
		add_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_bank_spe_zloti
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { c:HAN ?= this }
		add_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_bank_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { c:NGF ?= this }
		add_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_bank_thaler_prussian_thaler
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { c:PRU ?= this }
		add_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_bank_thaler_prussian_thaler
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { c:SAX ?= this }
		add_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_bank_thaler_saxon_thaler
	}
	else = {
		### No currency law at all. company_BasicBank carries no prestige currency
		### any more -- it cannot, one type serves every such country -- but it can
		### still own the bank.
		add_company = company_type:company_BasicBank
	}
}

### Keep the central bank company alive.
###
### This is the safety net, not the main road. The company that owns a central
### bank is chosen when the bank is built -- zz_ef_cm_create_owned_bank -- and
### this pass only catches a country that ended up with a central bank and no
### bank company at all.

zz_ef_cm_bank_company_upkeep = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes
			NOT = { zz_ef_cm_has_bank_company = yes }
		}
		zz_ef_cm_grant_bank_company = yes
	}

	### The slot, for a country whose company arrived with the bank.
	if = {
		limit = {
			zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes
			NOT = { has_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter }
		}
		add_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter
			NOT = { zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes }
		}
		remove_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter
	}

	### And the monopoly on central banks goes to whoever holds it.
	if = {
		limit = { zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes }
		zz_ef_cm_bank_monopoly = yes
	}
}
